profile_text.body:
Twilio is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker TWLO. Its own site describes it as a communications platform offering APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, alongside conversational AI and identity verification. The company frames the platform as connecting communication channels, customer context, and AI in one place, with pay-as-you-go pricing and flexible plans.

According to the site, the platform is built for what it calls the agentic era, letting humans and AI agents work together across channels. Twilio says AI agents draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, hand conversations to people when complexity or customer intent calls for it, and transfer full context so customers do not repeat themselves. The company describes its tools as building blocks for orchestrating context-rich conversations across channels.

The company's law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281. No individual cases, AI products, or MCP servers are listed for it.
